lead: A second `#[cfg(test)]` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs` fails a guard test, not the build.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/capability.rs`'s `nvs_stdlib_reaches_the_os_only_through_the_gate` scans a source file down to its *first* one and asserts there is one, so a test-only `mod` among the shipped ones hides everything under it. Declare a helper the whole crate's cases share inside the foot of `lib.rs`, as `granting` is.
